svg.title: Figure 6. Per-pair contrasts, held-out and training
svg.desc: Per (defense style, predicted enemy type) fixed-wave contrasts at wave 9 and wave 5 for Director v1, Director v2 and the counter arm, on the held-out seeds and on the training seeds.

g.text: Figure 6. Per-pair contrasts, held-out and training
held-out: 150 seeds, 614 population units; training: 20 seeds, 71 units (exploratory)
Wave 9: contrast of one defense on its predicted enemy type
style contrast of one (style, enemy type) pair
Wave 5: contrast of one defense on its predicted enemy type
style contrast of one (style, enemy type) pair
Filled marker: held-out seeds. Open marker (a lighter stroke for the x and + shapes): training seeds.
Each row is one defense style with the enemy type its missing tower is strong against; every mode shows its held-out estimate
(filled) and its training estimate (open) with 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals. Rows tagged 'few training units' have fewer
than 30 training units for at least one mode. Computed after the run, not pre-registered.
